newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway t-bill expansion gets 4.41 pct high yield.
newsitem.headline: Norway t-bill expansion gets 4.41 pct high yield.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Monday that a three billion crown expansion of treasury bill SS42 produced a highest yield of 4.41 percent.
The lowest yield was 4.35 percent and the weighted average rate was 4.39 percent. Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 42.5 percent allotment.
The bill was issued on March 14 with a nominal interest rate of 4.70 percent. It matures on March 19, 1997.
